tagline.en-MY: Uncle Lim’s corner kopitiam: kopi-o, teh tarik and roti bakar under the five-foot way.
tagline.ms-MY: Kopitiam simpang Pak Cik Lim: kopi-o, teh tarik dan roti bakar di kaki lima.

description.en-MY: A fictional family kopitiam reopened by Uncle Lim. Brew kopi, pull teh tarik by hand and serve kampung breakfasts.
description.ms-MY: Kopitiam keluarga rekaan yang dibuka semula oleh Pak Cik Lim. Bancuh kopi, tarik teh dengan tangan dan hidangkan sarapan kampung.

greeting.en-MY: Kopi-o or teh tarik today? Sit anywhere — the fan works, mostly.
greeting.ms-MY: Kopi-o atau teh tarik hari ini? Duduklah mana-mana — kipas berfungsi, kebanyakannya.

description.en-MY: Black coffee with sugar, kopitiam style.
Milky tea ‘pulled’ between two cups until it foams.
description.ms-MY: Teh susu yang ‘ditarik’ antara dua cawan sehingga berbuih.
Roti dibakar atas arang dengan mentega.

description.en-MY: Coconut rice with sambal, peanuts, egg and cucumber, wrapped in banana leaf.
description.ms-MY: Nasi santan dengan sambal, kacang, telur dan timun, dibungkus daun pisang.

tip.en-MY: Pour, then pull the tea high between the cups — twice — for a good foam.
tip.ms-MY: Tuang, kemudian tarik teh tinggi-tinggi antara cawan — dua kali — untuk buih yang cantik.

intro.en-MY: Anyone can brew tea. Pulling it — that takes practice. Make 3 teh tarik by hand with me?
intro.ms-MY: Sesiapa boleh bancuh teh. Menariknya — itu perlukan latihan. Buat 3 teh tarik dengan tangan bersama saya?

outro.en-MY: Look at that foam! My father would be proud of you.
outro.ms-MY: Tengok buih tu! Ayah saya pasti bangga dengan awak.

notice.en-MY: Kopitiam Lim is a fictional business made for this game. This menu is illustrative: no real prices, offers or certification are shown.
notice.ms-MY: Kopitiam Lim ialah perniagaan rekaan untuk permainan ini. Menu ini sekadar ilustrasi: tiada harga, tawaran atau pensijilan sebenar dipaparkan.
